comments.value: I would definitely enjoy if my friends could pick me up and let me ride sitting on their shoulders or whatever and they too have frequently expressed a desire to pick me up

You know some avatars can shaped as cars. So this idea will work perfect for vehicle-shaped avatars. Others can take seat in the vehicle and ride around.

From now it's strange to see vehicles but no one can step in and "ride" with another player.
Seats had a security flaw in unity version 2015, they'll likely add it back after the 2017 unity upgrade.
And make it possible for both vr and desktop and between them i.e desktop user picking up vr user and viceversa

Can we also have an option for small avatars, to have them be able to picked up, without forcing the big avatar to have a seat? Like a pickup component on a small avatar, that can be triggered with a gesture? Please!!
Avatar stations have returned in VRChat 2018.4.4!
We need to be able to pick people up
This doesn’t work with some a avatars like Siren Head, Iron Giant. etc. Why???

details: It´s would be nice if normal/big Player could pick up little Player on the shoulder, Hands or Head
title: Pick Up little Player
